description:
Returns facts about a lot by its row_id: area, perimeter, frontage, traditional
    custodians, a 0-100 constraint score, each planning and hazard layer checked on the lot
    (present or not, value, share of the lot), the unconstrained area, how its size compares
    with the suburb, distances to the coast, parks, water and transmission lines, elevation,
    and whether boundary files exist. A lot whose report the account bought has every answer,
    as on Pro. Layers checked on the lot but not included on the account's plan are listed in
    locked_layers; a locked layer is not absent. Spends no lookup.

row_id.description: The lot's row_id, as returned by the lot search or in the list of purchased reports
row_id.title: Row Id

name: mml_lot_facts

locked.description: Checked on this lot but not included on this plan; the answer comes with a Pro plan or the lot report. A locked layer is not absent
locked.title: Locked

statement.description: Attribution the licence requires to accompany the data
statement.title: Statement

vintage.description: The published date of the data
vintage.title: Vintage

files.description: Whether boundary files (DXF, KML, GeoJSON) exist here and this account can download them on the site
files.title: Files

layers.description: Layers answered for this account: present or not, value, coverage
layers.title: Layers

locked_line.description: Which answers are locked and how they are unlocked; present only when answers are locked
locked_line.title: Locked Line

lot.description: Identity, area, perimeter, frontage, custodians and data date
lot.title: Lot

more_present_count.description: How many locked layers apply to this lot
more_present_count.title: More Present Count

nearby.description: Distances to the coast, parks, water and transmission lines
nearby.title: Nearby

score.description: 0-100 constraint score (higher is less constrained) and how many answers are withheld
score.title: Score

suburb.description: Lot count and median lot area in the suburb
suburb.title: Suburb

unconstrained.description: Area left after exclusionary layers; locked unless Pro or the report for this lot
unconstrained.title: Unconstrained

unlocked_by.description: Why this lot's answers are all unlocked: the account's Pro plan, or the report the account bought for this lot (other lots stay at the account's plan)
unlocked_by.title: Unlocked By

title: Lot facts
